newsitem.title: USA: U.S. August zinc output slumps from July - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. August zinc output slumps from July - ABMS.

text.p: U.S. zinc slab production in August slumped to 15,603 short tons from the July total of 20,482 short tons, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics reported.
Output in August 1995 was 18,819 short tons.
In the first eight months of the year production totaled 153,472 short tons compared to 162,374 short tons in the same period last year.
Zinc slab shipments from U.S. plants were 15,640 short tons in August, down from 20,621 short tons in July, and 19,611 short tons in August 1995.
Shipments from January through August totaled 156,033 short tons, down from 164,010 short tons in the same period last year.
Inventories at producer plants were 3,617 short tons in August, barely changed from July.
